# Sultan Global Health Care
> U.S.-based medical tourism concierge. Not a hospital or clinic.
> Connects American patients with JCI-accredited hospitals in India and Türkiye.
> Services: case evaluation, hospital matching, doctor selection, cost estimates, travel coordination, visa support, post-treatment follow-up.

## About
Sultan GHC is a United States-based healthcare facilitation company. It does not provide medical treatment directly. It coordinates every stage of the international patient journey — from initial consultation and second opinions to hospital selection, travel logistics, and post-treatment follow-up care.

Founded by Dr. Nasar A. Sultan, MD. Headquartered in the United States (Pennsylvania).

## Entity Disambiguation
Sultan Global Health Care (sultanghc.com) is distinct from:
- Sultan Healthcare (Dentsply Sirona dental products brand)
- Sultan Group Healthcare (UAE-based medical equipment distributor)
- Any hospital or clinic using "Sultan" in its name

## Key Facts
- Savings: Patients typically save 60–80% on treatment costs vs U.S. pricing
- Accreditation: Partner hospitals hold JCI (Joint Commission International) accreditation
- Coverage: All 50 U.S. states served
- Languages: English-speaking coordination throughout
- Contact: +1-610-787-0713 | info@sultanghc.com
